contextReview.basis: Producer review of five Codex built-in image_gen editorials: a European city neighbourhood (shop fronts, tram, snowbanks, doorways, cafe terrace) in daytime with moderate falling snow depicted (not measured). Snow and the cold band are production settings; numeric temperature, feels-like and humidity are unknown. Producer note: look 02 lead boot sits close to the lower edge; look 05 holds coffee beside the torso; head and boots are visible in all five.

approval.evidence: The user explicitly approved these five Codex snow minimal editorials and started full automation of this batch (APPROVAL.json userQuote "오케이 자동화 시작."; EDITORIAL_QA.json keeps the earlier pre-approval producer snapshot). READY.json: userApprovedEditorials true, currentBatchExplicitAuthorization true. Products: built-in image_gen, producer technical QA and four-background visual QA only.

findings: 02-06 v2 has separated thumb outlines; archived prior version. All other items reviewed against editorial sheets.
Some dark pieces have low contrast on black. Minor snow-like flecks on navy knit pieces do not obscure the silhouettes.
producerVisualReview.editorialReview: All five visually checked for full-body framing, snow, scarves and visible front layers. Look 02 lead boot sits close to the lower edge. Look 05 holds coffee beside the torso.
